# 投影矩阵和最小二乘

```{python}
#| output: asis

from sympy import Matrix
from books.assets.reading_lab_display import display

A = Matrix([
    [1, 1],
    [1, 2],
    [1, 3],
])
b = Matrix([1, 2, 2])

# display(A.gauss_jordan_solve(b)) # 无精确解，报错 ValueError: Linear system has no solution
display((A.T * A).gauss_jordan_solve(A.T * b))  # 看懂原理
display(A.pinv() * b)
display(A.pinv_solve(b))
display(x_hat, _ := A.solve_least_squares(b))  # 使用软件

display(A.T * A)
display(A.T * b)

display("x_hat", x_hat)
display("p", p := A * x_hat)
display("e", e := b - p)

display(e.dot(p))
display(A.T * e)
```
